newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron Ill. nuke at 16 pct power.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron Ill. nuke at 16 pct power.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison's 1,105 megawatt Byron 1 nuclear unit, shut since Feb 14 for maintenance, was operating at 16 percent power early Thursday morning, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
Plant operators were "troubleshooting a rod position indication problem," the NRC report stated.
No further details were given on when the unit would likely resume power ascension.
The unit was originally shut to repair a leaky feedwater pump gland.
The facility's adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
